case.title: Climate reporting package workshop (fictional)
case.brief: Choose a climate reporting package that every participant can accept under their private simulated mandate, or establish an impasse by ruling out every package. Publicly rule out packages when doing so would clarify the search. The menu and all mandates are fictional. They do not describe national policy or a Council decision.
